Use: Alfalfa (grown for Forage, Fodder, Seed, Straw, and Hay)
App. Equipment: Ground sprayers, fixed or rotary winged aircraft, sprinkler-type overhead chemigation equipment
PPE: Long sleeved shirt and long pants; Chemical resistant gloves made out of: barrier laminate, butyl rubber ≥ 14 mils, nitrile rubber ≥ 14 mils, neoprene rubber ≥ 14 mils, natural rubber ≥ 14 mils, polyethylene, polyvinyl chloride ≥ 14 mils, or viton ≥ 14 mils; Shoes and socks
Additional Information: Minimum Application Volume: 10 Gallons/Acre (Ground); 3 Gallons/Acre (Aerial); Maximum flupyradifurone per calendar year is 0.365 lb ai/A, regardless of formulation or method of application.
Geographic Restrictions: No aerial application in New York State. Not for sale, distribution or use in Nassau and Suffolk Counties (except under FIFRA 24(c)/SLN).
Drift Restrictions: Max Release Height (ft): 10, ASABE Droplet Size: Coarse
On-field Non-target Species Restrictions: Pollinators: recommended that foliar insecticides are applied late in the afternoon

App. Equipment: Chemigation low-pressure drip, trickle, micro-sprinkler, injection for planting, potting hole drench or post-transplant drench
PPE: Long sleeved shirt and long pants; Chemical resistant gloves made out of: barrier laminate, butyl rubber ≥ 14 mils, nitrile rubber ≥ 14 mils, neoprene rubber ≥ 14 mils, natural rubber ≥ 14 mils, polyethylene, polyvinyl chloride ≥ 14 mils, or viton ≥ 14 mils; Shoes and socks
Additional Information: Chemigation into root zone through low-pressure drip, trickle, micro-sprinkler or equiv. equipment; Injection below the eventual seed line prior to planting. Place product 3-4 inches below seed line; Potting hole drench at transplanting; Post-transplant drench following setting and covering; Maximum flupyradifurone per calendar year is 0.365 lb ai/A, regardless of formulation or method of application.
Geographic Restrictions: No aerial application in New York State. Not for sale, distribution or use in Nassau and Suffolk Counties (except under FIFRA 24(c)/SLN).
Soil Restrictions: For injection: Place SIVANTO 400 SL 3 - 4 inches below seed line.
Additional Restrictions for Use/Use Site: DO NOT tank mix with azole fungicides (FRAC group 3) during bloom period; No aerial application in New York State.
